chapters.text: 18[Contravention of order made during search action.]

children.title: OFFENCES AND PROSECUTION
children.text_before_subsections: Whoever contravenes any order referred to in section 247(4) shall be punishable with 19[simple imprisonment up to two years and with fine].

sections.title: OFFENCES AND PROSECUTION
sections.text_before_subsections: Whoever contravenes any order referred to in section 247(4) shall be punishable with 19[simple imprisonment up to two years and with fine].

footnotes.text: Sub. for "Contravention of order made under section 247." by Act No. 4 of 2026, w.e.f. 1-4-2026.
Sub. for "rigorous imprisonment which may extend to two years and shall also be liable to fine" by Act No. 4 of 2026, w.e.f. 1-4-2026.
